name: Baz & Wilder
bio: Baz & Wilder are an award winning commercial directing duo (and IRL married couple) based out of New Orleans, LA, where together they built the video-first creative agency FatHappy. Their work blends the colorful design of visual artist Amber “Baz” Vogts with Matthew Wilder’s honest, documentary-style approach and commitment to working with real people, crafting a cinematic world that pushes audiences to laugh, cry…or both.
